notes: Full description: Three lint check_cert implementations in pkix-lint/src/cabf_tls_br.rs (SanRequiredLint::check_cert line 343-347, EkuServerAuthLint::check_cert line 402-405, BcCaFlagLint::check_cert line 463-471) use the pattern: 'let extensions = match &cert.tbs_certificate.extensions { Some(exts) => exts, None => return LintResult::Error(...) };'. MSRV is 1.73 and let-else was stabilized in 1.65. The idiomatic Rust 1.65+ form is: 'let Some(extensions) = &cert.tbs_certificate.extensions else { return LintResult::Error(...); };'. This is a readability/style improvement (P4 — opinion), not a correctness or performance issue. The current code is functionally correct.
title: RUSTY: let-else preferred over match-return in cabf_tls_br lints
